method: Three independent read-only reviews ran in parallel against the Phase 9 tree (money/mandate, security/notifications, frontend). Each was instructed to read the code and its callers, produce concrete failing cases with file:line and a smallest fix, and change nothing. Every finding is either fixed in a named commit or recorded below as accepted with its reason.

findings.finding: The delegation mint stored ratification_sha256 but never verified it, so a cap above any mandate and an arbitrary hash returned 201.
findings.disposition: FIXED 8f58fe2: the server recomputes the canonical mandate hash (scope, cap, expiry, ordered conditions) and refuses a mismatch; a missing hash with mandate_version is a refusal; red-green proven (4 tests fail with the gate disabled).

findings.finding: tools/live_gates.py logger signature made every live mandate case raise TypeError.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee.

findings.finding: The bid gate's AI_ENABLED environment flag was inert because explicit settings kwargs win, so the quote answered 403 and the gate could never pass.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: settings_for receives ai_enabled, the Gemini key and the public base URL explicitly.

findings.finding: Mandate conditions are stored but no surface evaluates them.
findings.disposition: RECORDED Q-2026-11-08-39 and in the README: the cap, scope and expiry are enforced; conditions advise. Implementing an enforcing surface needs an additive response field and a CR.

findings.finding: ai-schemas section 9 says an invalid condition is dropped and reported as an ambiguity; the closed schema refuses the whole proposal instead.
findings.disposition: RECORDED as a deliberate fail-closed deviation in mandate_gate.json: the schema is closed, so an unknown predicate never reaches persistence. Adding a repair-and-ambiguity path is a later change.

findings.finding: agent_market counted every buyer order for delegated entries, not provider-write states, and its self-check creates none, so zero was guaranteed.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: the query is restricted to AUTHORIZING..VOIDED plus AUTH_FAILED and CAPTURE_FAILED, and the derivation is printed in the report.

findings.finding: The harness's cleanup claim was false and its delete order violated the awards-to-revision foreign key.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: awards are deleted first and the evidence states exactly what cleanup removes and what stays.

findings.finding: mandate_gate.json said passed while its note admitted the live run was open.
findings.disposition: FIXED: the file now scopes itself to the deterministic gate and names the live command and its status separately.

findings.finding: The 'never wider' test asserted the values it had passed in.
findings.disposition: FIXED 8f58fe2: the raised-cap POST with a stale hash must answer 422.

reviews.verdict: ONE MAJOR FIXED, ONE MINOR PARTIALLY FIXED, ONE DOCS FIXED

findings.finding: The unread badge never appeared because it was only set while opening the panel, which immediately marked everything read.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: a mount fetch seeds the badge without marking; a test asserts the badge before opening and that no POST is sent.

findings.finding: A tab with the cookie but no CSRF token cannot mark read; the auto-POST failed silently.
findings.disposition: PARTIALLY FIXED 94540ee: the POST is skipped and the panel says why. Reissuing a CSRF token from the session is a separate endpoint and is not claimed.

findings.finding: The sandbox README named the wrong CI protection (dummy credentials are exported; the real guards are the marker filter and the CI skip).
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee.

reviews.clean_checks: Owner scoping uses only the session principal; CSRF is enforced by require_session; unread is the same predicate as /me over all rows with the limit applied to items only; payload renders as text with no HTML injection or payload-driven navigation; the interactive gate cannot run in CI and C-16 is pure.

reviews.verdict: FOUR MAJORS FIXED, ONE PARTIAL, MINORS FIXED

findings.finding: Unread badge could never appear.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee (same fix as the security lane).

findings.finding: The audit page reported a failed seal when the public key simply had not loaded.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: a key-not-loaded branch says it could not be checked.

findings.finding: A throwing recompute left 'Recalculating…' forever.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: a catch lands three 'could not run in this browser' rows.

findings.finding: A refetch could change the rendered mandate or drop a pool without clearing ratification.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: ratification resets on any rendered-text change, selected ids prune to open pools, and 8f58fe2 makes the server verify the bound fields.

findings.finding: The Discover capacity meter showed every pool at or above minimum as full, duplicated.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: the meter and its CSS are removed.

findings.finding: '+180.00 saved' was a saving that did not happen.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: the callout is removed; the budget note already states the delta correctly.

findings.finding: Category filter compared a lowercased key to a raw id and a stale category could strand the grid.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: both sides lowercase, an effective category falls back to ALL, and Clear search clears both.

findings.finding: The receipt modal had no Escape, focus move or restore.
findings.disposition: PARTIALLY FIXED 94540ee: Escape closes and the sheet takes focus. It is not a native dialog; recorded here.

findings.finding: The inbox trigger lost its accessible name on narrow screens and the close target was 28 px.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: an explicit aria-label with the unread count and a 44 px close target.

findings.finding: A failed mark-read produced the load-error message over rendered rows.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: the POST has its own catch.

findings.finding: Dead CSS for the removed guarantee and savings blocks.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee.

findings.finding: A status role with an aria-label could suppress the announcement, and a stale place verdict survived a pool change.
findings.disposition: FIXED 94540ee: the label is gone and the place clears on pool change.

recorded_not_fixed: An invalid condition refuses the whole proposal instead of being dropped with an ambiguity; the schema is closed and no repair path exists (fail-closed, recorded).
A session with a cookie but no CSRF token cannot mark notifications read; the panel says so rather than pretending.
The receipt sheet is a hand-rolled overlay with Escape and initial focus, not a native dialog.
